new.s: In the Battle of Talikota (1565), the Vijayanagara Empire fought against
o: A confederacy of the Deccan Sultanates
new.x: Vijayanagara under Aliya Rama Raya fought the confederacy of the Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, Bidar). The Bahmani kingdom had already broken up into these Sultanates, so 'Bahmani' is a common trap. The Mughals and the Gajapatis were not parties to the battle.
